metadata.description: A collection of plugins for Specs

plugins.name: linear
plugins.description: A Specs plugin for creating Linear issues from raw client input

plugins.name: code
plugins.description: A Specs plugin with cross-language code authoring conventions

plugins.name: crit
plugins.description: Review and comment on plans, code diffs, and frontend elements, then send feedback directly to your agent.

plugins.name: gh-stack
plugins.description: Manages stacked PRs and splits multi-part work into reviewable branches with the gh-stack GitHub CLI extension.

plugins.name: git-workflow
plugins.description: Atomic-commit Git workflow skills: folding changes into the right commit (amend/edit/fixup), conflict resolution, reflog-based undo, and bisect debugging, plus shared conventions (rebase-over-merge, stashing, commit-message style).
